A_note: Same configuration, two separate evaluations: differences 0.0, +0.6, -2.5 pp. Method differences of about 2 pp on one model are inside this floor.

calibration.caveat: three replicate pairs only; the identical 69.9 for opus may be a reused run, which would make tasks look more deterministic than they are

C_overfitting_contrast.reading: In-sample pass@1 gains of Harness Evolution are -0.8 (no tests) and +2.1 (tests) on average, both inside the replicate floor; held-out is 0.0. There is no in-sample gain for overfitting to explain. 'Fails to generalize' is supported as 'no gain anywhere at pass@1', not as a train/test gap. The in-sample gain the paper contrasts with is pass@5 (79.0 vs pass@1 base), which measures selection among 5 tries, not a better harness.
